input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: 11.1 gives up to six months' transition assistance at expiring Order Form rates (with continued scope and service levels), 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for fee disputes, and 11.3 requires secure deletion after confirmed return with written officer certification, limited to a legally required copy that stays protected. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return data). No redline needed.
